name: Non-syndromic Intercalary Limb Defects

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical Diagnostic Criteria for Non-syndromic Intercalary Limb Defects

criteria.description: Presence of a segmental absence of the central portion of a limb with preservation of proximal and distal elements
Lack of associated systemic or syndromic abnormalities on clinical and genetic evaluation
Radiographic evidence confirming intercalary limb deficiency without other skeletal anomalies
Negative or non-contributory family history of limb malformations
Absence of pathogenic variants in genes known to cause syndromic limb defects

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: All three major criteria must be met: presence of intercalary limb defect, absence of syndromic features, and radiologic confirmation.
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is recommended to exclude syndromic causes but is not diagnostic.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Segmental absence of the central limb segment
Preservation of proximal and distal limb elements despite central deficiency
searchTerms: normal bones near missing limb segment
preserved limb ends despite central loss
intact proximal and distal limb parts

common.symptomName: Reduced limb length due to segmental deficiency
searchTerms: reduced limb length due to bone loss
limb length decrease from segment absence

common.symptomName: Limited range of motion in adjacent joints

occasional.symptomName: Mild limb length discrepancy in contralateral limb
searchTerms: slight difference in opposite limb length
walking changes to compensate limb difference
adjusted gait due to limb issues

occasional.symptomName: Soft tissue contractures adjacent to defect
searchTerms: contracted skin or muscles beside limb defect

occasional.symptomName: Localized skin hypoplasia over defect area
searchTerms: thin or underdeveloped skin over defect

rare.symptomName: Associated minor nail abnormalities on affected limb
searchTerms: minor nail changes on affected limb

rare.symptomName: Mild sensory deficits distal to defect
Vascular anomalies adjacent to limb defect
searchTerms: vascular changes adjacent to limb problem

imaging: X-ray demonstrating segmental absence of limb bones with preservation of proximal and distal segments
MRI to assess soft tissue and vascular structures adjacent to defect
genetic: No pathogenic variants identified in known syndromic limb defect genes
Negative chromosomal microarray and targeted gene panels
other: Clinical examination confirming isolated limb involvement without systemic features

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of systemic or syndromic abnormalities
Positive genetic findings in syndromic genes
Complete absence of limb or distal limb segments
No preservation of proximal and distal elements simultaneously
Often associated with other congenital anomalies
Severe limb shortening with absent intermediate segments
Distal limb elements attached close to trunk

redFlags: Presence of systemic abnormalities suggesting syndromic diagnosis
Progressive limb deformity or worsening functional impairment
Signs of vascular compromise or ischemia in affected limb
